messages.content: Ano ang puwedeng gawin para hindi maalat ang adobo?

{"answer":"Bawasan ang soy sauce at dagdagan ang lasa gamit ang suka, bawang, paminta, o laurel. Tikman muna bago magdagdag ng asin. Kung may sodium limit ka, sundin ang target ng clinician mo.","needs_fallback":false}

Anong Filipino ulam ang may gulay at hindi deep-fried?

{"answer":"Puwedeng tinola na may gulay, pinakbet na kaunti ang bagoong, o inihaw na isda na may gulay. Nag-iiba ang sangkap at alat ng bawat recipe, kaya i-adjust sa iyong needs.","needs_fallback":false}
Is garlic a replacement for blood pressure medicine?
{"answer":"No. Do not replace or stop prescribed blood pressure medicine with garlic. Ask your clinician before changing treatment or using supplements.","needs_fallback":true}

Why can two servings of the same Filipino dish have different nutrition?
{"answer":"Recipes, ingredient brands, cooking methods, and serving sizes differ, so nutrition values are estimates. Use the actual recipe and portion for a closer estimate.","needs_fallback":false}
